name: top_dist_div_one_add_triangle
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] (x y z : X) : dist x z / (1 + dist x z) ≤ dist x y / (1 + dist x y) + dist y z / (1 + dist y z)
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] (x y z : X), dist x z / (1 + dist x z) ≤ dist x y / (1 + dist x y) + dist y z / (1 + dist y z)
informal: The bounded metric d/(1+d) satisfies the triangle inequality — t ↦ t/(1+t) is monotone and subadditive on [0,∞); combine with dist_triangle.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] (x y z : X), dist x z / (1 + dist x z) ≤ dist x y / (1 + dist x y) + dist y z / (1 + dist y z)
